verdict.rationale: Marqeta's docs show a full self-serve program-management API (card products, users, card creation, velocity/authorization controls, disputes, JIT funding, sandbox) that let a founder build a card program without deep banking infrastructure, per marqeta-docs-1/14/24/33/26/21/25. However, the pack contains no explicit documentation of BIN sponsorship or card-network membership being handled by Marqeta, nor any stated signup-to-first-live-card timeline. missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship/issuing-bank partnership details, network membership handling, documented time-to-launch metric.
